_comment: The two axes of the matrix, plus the risk legend. Definitions must match the workbook reference scale exactly. If you change wording here, change it in the workbook too.

autonomyLevels.name: No execution
autonomyLevels.detail: The system answers, suggests or explains. It has no tools, no write access and cannot take an action. All impact runs through a human deciding what to do with the output.

autonomyLevels.name: Bounded assistant
autonomyLevels.detail: Drafts and proposes inside a fixed boundary. A human executes every action.

autonomyLevels.name: Supervised actor
autonomyLevels.detail: Takes actions while a human watches and can intervene before or during execution.

autonomyLevels.name: Conditional agent
autonomyLevels.detail: Executes autonomously inside declared guardrails, pausing for approval when it hits a restricted zone.

autonomyLevels.name: Delegated agent
autonomyLevels.detail: Runs bounded workflows on its own. Humans review exceptions rather than every action.

autonomyLevels.name: Open agent
autonomyLevels.detail: Acts with minimal per-transaction control. Oversight is aggregate, not per action.

impactClasses.name: Negligible
impactClasses.detail: Incorrect output produced, but nothing consequential follows from it.

impactClasses.name: Limited
impactClasses.detail: Effect stays within the affected team, system or individual and is cheap to undo.

impactClasses.name: Significant
impactClasses.summary: Material customer, data, financial or operational impact
impactClasses.detail: Correction is possible, but the failure already reached the user population.

impactClasses.name: Critical
impactClasses.summary: Severe, potentially irreversible or widespread impact
impactClasses.detail: Consequences cannot be restored once the output has been relied upon.

riskLegend.label: High
riskLegend.note: Formal assurance and stronger human oversight.

riskLegend.label: Critical
riskLegend.note: Maximum assurance and independent validation. Where even maximum assurance is insufficient for the autonomy and impact combination, the cell posture is Prohibited / redesign.

auditCategories.name: Evidence of risks
auditCategories.detail: Risk assessment, impact, classification assumptions, affected systems and stops.

auditCategories.name: Evidence of control design
auditCategories.detail: Policies, guardrails, workflow boundaries, permissions, limits and monitoring.

auditCategories.name: Evidence of control effectiveness
auditCategories.detail: Test results, monitoring evidence, exception handling and control failure tests.

auditCategories.name: Evidence of approval & oversight
auditCategories.detail: Human-in-the-loop configuration, approver authority, approval logs and exception approvals.

auditCategories.name: Evidence of resilience & recovery
auditCategories.detail: Rollback tests, failover evidence, incident response and recovery ownership.
